name: Mahindra Logistics Ltd
title: Mahindra Logistics Ltd - 540768 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Turnaround logistics story: FY26 reported PAT ₹2.3 crore vs ₹35.8 crore loss, Express GM positive at 1.3% but still EBITDA-negative (₹31 crore loss); management gives no hard EBITDA timeline.

triggers.label: Express GM turned positive, Q4 ₹6.6 crore
triggers.quote: sequential GM improvement in this business for three consecutive quarters from INR20 lakh in Q2 FY26 to INR2.7 crores in Q3 FY26 and INR6.6 crores in Q4

triggers.label: Express industry consolidation easing competition
triggers.quote: I would agree with your observation that there is some consolidation of the industry has happened

triggers.label: Freight forwarding hit by West Asia
triggers.quote: we are beginning to see impact of the West Asia war on the global trade. And obviously, that would impact our Freight Forwarding business

triggers.label: Express volume growth mid-to-high teens
triggers.quote: our volume growth, you can think about this like a mid- to high teens kind of a volume growth

guidance.quote: we are driving towards a mid- to high-teen kind of growth for this business
we will reduce our white space by 95%. So we have still some more work to do by September of this year

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are currently at that stage and maybe slightly better than that on our glide path

red_flags.label: Large ECL provision on aged receivables
red_flags.quote: We have taken some action on aged receivables based on our assessment of recoverability or lack thereof

red_flags.label: Express EBITDA still negative; KPI disclosure dropped
red_flags.quote: since the last quarter, we have stopped sharing that number

evasions.quote: we have stopped sharing that number
that's not right for us to share because that would give too much of information to our competition
That's an internal metric, Rehan. We won't be able to share that.
